_comment: Offline tools/list from the official legacy npm server. Supersedes the earlier unverified hosted 12-tool snapshot. This is schema evidence only, not authentication, onboarding, or hosted-server evidence.
version_note: The initialize response reports serverInfo.version 1.0.0; the npm package tested was explicitly pinned to 0.20.0.
auth_pattern: Legacy local CIRCLECI_TOKEN environment variable; placeholder used for discovery, no real credential.

tool_surface_observed.naming_convention: Caller prefixes vary with host and registration name. Use actual runtime discovery.

current_hosted_route.auth: OAuth2 preferred; Personal API Token fallback when the host cannot complete OAuth2.
current_hosted_route.live_verification: Not tested by this offline capture. Discover its own tools and perform a real authenticated read.

drift_check_recipe: Start the explicitly selected package version in a temporary stdio process with a placeholder CIRCLECI_TOKEN and DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true. Do not load user credentials or register the server in a host.
Send MCP initialize, notifications/initialized, then tools/list. Capture names and input schemas; record the package version separately from serverInfo.version.
Do not call tools/call during this offline check. Stop the temporary process after discovery.
Compare the observed names and schemas with the version-scoped skill table. Hosted/CLI routes have their own tool surfaces; do not copy this count onto them.

For connection verification, use the actual intended caller and credentials to make one authenticated read. Config presence, schema discovery, and a successful transport response alone do not prove access.
